more_info.banned_in:
JECFA records withdrawn specifications in 1984; this is not a national ban.
No current country-wide food-use ban was confirmed in the regulatory sources checked in 2026.
EU and US food-additive permissions for this exact entry were not confirmed in the sources checked in 2026.
more_info.overview: Alkannin is a hydroxy-naphthoquinone pigment associated with dyer's alkanet. The natural colour is obtained by extracting the plant. Its red-brown pigment has a historical food-colour identity under INS 103. JECFA retains the identity record but records withdrawn specifications, so the name does not establish a current food-use permission.
more_info.origin: Plant-derived. The natural dye is obtained by extracting dyer's alkanet, Alkanna tinctoria.
